messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach on shared-gpu-pool-prod detected. p99=5.0s (SLO=1.0s), p95=1.8s (SLO=0.5s). Auto-page to oncall. window start ~1995678800.
Rina Shah: Rina oncall, I'm taking this. Any immediate customer tickets?
Priya Anand: CS seeing two tickets referencing streaming stalls: DataWave (#8810) and ClinicFlow (#8811). Both report pauses in token streaming but no error codes.
Ethan Cole: grabbing tenant heatmap now. Top noisy tenant looks like deepviz-ops. High KV spill rate and frequent fsyncs. Node hotspots: gpu-node-9 / gpu-node-10.
SRE-bot: TAG: blkio_pressure detected on gpu-node-9. Top cgroup: tenant-deepviz-ops. blkio.await spiking above 60ms.
Devon Park: running `iostat -x 1 10` on gpu-node-9. Observed NVMe avg await 35-70ms, many small write IOs. Looks like checkpoint flush churn.
Rina Shah: root cause hypothesis: noisy neighbor (deepviz-ops) performing heavy checkpointing and spilling to NVMe causing IO tail latency and streaming stalls. Mitigation plan: immediate throttling + eviction to dedicated-temp. Who can perform live mitigation?
Ethan Cole: I can apply admission controller caps and schedule eviction. Devon can tune blkio weight on the host.
Devon Park: increasing tenant cgroup blkio.throttle read/write limits and bumping blkio.weight for shared pool temporarily. Commands:
```
# increase weight for shared pool
echo 1500 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/redwood/shared-pool/blkio.weight
# lower weight for noisy tenant
echo 300 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/redwood/tenant-deepviz-ops/blkio.weight
```
Ethan Cole: patching admission controller for tenant-deepviz-ops to reduce concurrency and seq length.
```
PATCH /admission/tenants/deepviz-ops
{ "limits": { "concurrent_sessions": 1, "max_seq_len": 2048 } }
```
Ethan Cole: starting rolling eviction of deepviz pods to dedicated-temp pool. Evicting one replica at a time to avoid overload.
SRE-bot: ACTION: admission limits applied by Ethan Cole. blkio changes applied by Devon Park. Eviction job EVT-990 initiated.
Priya Anand: CS note: DataWave reported streaming stalls between 1995678805-1995678950 with p99 ~3.8s. ClinicFlow saw p99 ~2.4s. Priya to draft proactive messages.
Devon Park: after blkio adjustments and the first replica eviction, p99 decreased from 5.0s -> 1.6s in ~70s. p95 down to 0.6s. Some residual stalls during migration window.
Ethan Cole: one pod failed to reschedule due to node label mismatch; manually annotated pod with `redwood/pool=dedicated-temp` and forced schedule.
Rina Shah: monitoring shows p99 at 0.98s and p95 0.45s now. SLOs recovered. Great.
Morgan Lee: logging artifacts to incident ticket: iostat, blktrace, `nvidia-smi` snapshots, admission controller audit events, and pod scheduling events.
Ethan Cole: recommend short-term retention of admission caps for deepviz-ops for 2 hours and keep routing pref to dedicated for large models for 30 minutes.
Devon Park: proposal for postmortem: - assess tenant autoscale/ramp policy - per-tenant blkio floors and guardrails - placement rules by KV-spill frequency - streaming backpressure improvements (per-token latency histograms)
Priya Anand: drafted customer messages for DataWave and ClinicFlow: apology, brief cause summary (noisy-tenant NVMe IO saturation), mitigation steps (throttled/moved tenant), assurances (no data loss), ETA for postmortem. Sending after ops review.
SRE-bot: TASKS CREATED: TASK-7801 (blkio alert rule), TASK-7802 (auto-evict rule for sustained blkio>80%), TASK-7803 (placement-policy doc). Assigned: Devon, Ethan, Morgan.
Rina Shah: lowering severity to P2, incident state mitigated -> monitoring. Scheduling postmortem within 48h. Handing off watch to Morgan for 45m. I'll be available for escalation.
Morgan Lee: ack. I'll keep an eye on the routing and blkio alerts and update the ticket if anything flares.
Priya Anand: CS will send customer messages in 20 minutes and offer follow-up calls to DataWave and ClinicFlow.
Ethan Cole: closing active page for oncall. All mitigation artifacts uploaded.
Rina Shah: thanks team, solid response. We'll reconvene for postmortem and finalize permanent mitigations.
